name: Đà Nẵng

queries.query: cổng thông tin đất đai Đà Nẵng dữ liệu địa chính 560.400 thửa tạm bảo trì
queries.scope: Verify the municipal land-information portal status and parcel database.
queries.result: City agency response dated 2025 says the city portal is under maintenance while upgrading the database for administrative reorganization, and directs official requests to the city land-registration office. A municipal investment portal reports the older public portal mapped 560,400 parcels.

queries.query: Da Nang official land information portal cadastral parcel database city land registration office
queries.scope: Cross-check municipal source and current public portal availability.
queries.result: English-indexed city services point to the city land information directory; no current anonymous full-vector parcel endpoint was verified. City-maintained portal update and office workflow are confirmed by first-party Vietnamese sources.

portals.name: Đà Nẵng Land Information Portal
portals.operator: Đà Nẵng Department of Natural Resources and Environment / city land registration office
portals.observation: Historical city portal provided parcel-click map information. Official 2025 response reports maintenance and database transition; callers are directed to the city land registration office for official data.

requests.observation: Official city response states former portal is under maintenance during database modernization after administrative reorganization; official parcel information available through city land-registration office.
City investment-promotion portal describes historical public land portal and 560,400 spatial parcels; historical capability only, not current service availability.
